axil_crossbar_addr.summary: AXI-lite crossbar address decoder: a 2-state FSM compares the incoming address against per-master base/width regions, registers the selected master index or a decode error, and issues address, write-command and reply-command valids before acknowledging the slave.

blocks.name: Decode controller
blocks.description: FSM sequencing decode and completion of address/command handshakes

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: IDLE/DECODE controller: decodes address then waits for all outputs accepted

blocks.name: Address decoder
blocks.description: Region match logic producing master select and decode error

anchors.name: match
anchors.why: Address region match flag choosing successful decode versus decode error

anchors.name: m_select_reg
anchors.why: Decoded master index driving m_select, m_wc_select and m_rc_select

anchors.name: m_decerr_reg
anchors.why: Decode error flag reported on write and reply command outputs

anchors.name: s_axil_aaddr
anchors.why: Incoming address compared against master regions

anchors.name: s_axil_aprot
anchors.why: Protection bits blocking access to secure masters

anchors.name: s_axil_avalid
anchors.why: Address valid starting decode in IDLE

anchors.name: s_axil_aready
anchors.why: Address accept pulse once all command outputs complete

blocks.name: Command outputs
blocks.description: Address, write-command and reply-command output handshakes

anchors.name: m_select
anchors.why: Selected master port index output

anchors.name: m_axil_avalid
anchors.why: Address valid to selected master

anchors.name: m_axil_aready
anchors.why: Selected master accepts address

anchors.name: m_wc_valid
anchors.why: Write command valid, enabled by WC_OUTPUT

anchors.name: m_wc_ready
anchors.why: Write command accepted

anchors.name: m_rc_valid
anchors.why: Reply command valid carrying select and decerr

anchors.name: m_rc_ready
anchors.why: Reply command accepted

axil_register_wr.summary: AXI-Lite write-path register slice: per-channel (AW, W, B) parameter-selected bypass, simple register, or skid buffer that registers valid/ready and payload between slave and master ports.

blocks.name: AW channel register
blocks.description: Registers write address/prot and valid with ready back-pressure

anchors.name: s_axil_awvalid
anchors.why: Slave write-address valid captured into AW register stage

anchors.name: s_axil_awaddr
anchors.why: Slave write address registered toward master port

anchors.name: s_axil_awready
anchors.why: AW ready back to slave, asserted when output register will be empty

anchors.name: m_axil_awaddr
anchors.why: Registered write address driven to master

anchors.name: m_axil_awvalid
anchors.why: Registered AW valid to downstream master

anchors.name: m_axil_awready
anchors.why: Downstream AW ready that drains the AW register

blocks.name: W channel register
blocks.description: Registers write data/strobe and valid with ready back-pressure

anchors.name: s_axil_wdata
anchors.why: Slave write data registered into W channel slice

anchors.name: s_axil_wvalid
anchors.why: Slave write-data valid captured into W register

anchors.name: s_axil_wready
anchors.why: W ready back to slave from W register stage

anchors.name: s_axil_wstrb
anchors.why: Byte strobes registered alongside write data

anchors.name: m_axil_wdata
anchors.why: Registered write data driven to master

anchors.name: m_axil_wvalid
anchors.why: Registered W valid to downstream

anchors.name: m_axil_wready
anchors.why: Downstream W ready that drains the W register

blocks.name: B channel register
blocks.description: Registers write response from master back to slave

anchors.name: genblk3.s_axil_bvalid_reg
anchors.why: Registered write-response valid presented to slave side

anchors.name: genblk3.m_axil_bready_reg
anchors.why: Registered B ready to master, high when response register will be empty

anchors.name: genblk3.s_axil_bresp_reg
anchors.why: Registered write response code from master

anchors.name: genblk3.store_axil_b_input_to_output
anchors.why: Load enable capturing master bresp into output register

anchors.name: m_axil_bvalid
anchors.why: Master response valid captured into B register

anchors.name: s_axil_bready
anchors.why: Slave-side response ready that clears B register

anchors.name: stage_valid
anchors.why: memory array

anchors.name: stage_enc
anchors.why: memory array

arbiter.summary: Parameterized arbiter: two priority encoders (plain and round-robin-masked) pick a requester, registered into one-hot grant, encoded index and valid, with optional blocking hold.

blocks.name: Grant controller
blocks.description: Next-grant logic and grant registers selecting one requester per cycle.

anchors.name: grant_reg
anchors.why: Registered one-hot grant vector chosen from priority-encoded requests; drives grant port.

anchors.name: grant_valid
anchors.why: Grant valid output from grant_valid_reg; used for blocking hold check.

anchors.name: grant_encoded
anchors.why: Binary index of the granted port, from grant_encoded_reg.

anchors.name: request_valid
anchors.why: Any-request flag from priority encoder; enables issuing a new grant.

anchors.name: request_index
anchors.why: Encoded index of highest-priority request, loaded into grant_encoded_next.

blocks.name: Priority encoders
blocks.description: Plain and round-robin-masked priority encoders over requests.

anchors.name: masked_request_valid
anchors.why: Masked-request present flag choosing masked grant in round-robin mode.

anchors.name: mask_reg
anchors.why: Round-robin priority mask applied to requests; inactive with default ARB_TYPE_ROUND_ROBIN=0.

ungrouped_anchors.name: request
ungrouped_anchors.why: Per-port request vector fed to both priority encoders.

ungrouped_anchors.name: acknowledge
ungrouped_anchors.why: Per-port acknowledge releasing a held grant in blocking-ack mode.

axil_crossbar_wr.summary: AXI-Lite write crossbar: per-slave address decoders and response-routing FIFOs, per-master round-robin AW arbiters with write-data routing and B-select FIFOs, joined by valid/ready matrices with register slices on both sides.

blocks.name: slave_addr_decode
blocks.description: Per-slave address decoder issuing master select, write command and response command.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].a_select
anchors.why: Decoded master index for slave write address; routes avalid into the crossbar matrix.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].m_wc_valid
anchors.why: Write command valid from address decoder loading write route.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].m_rc_valid
anchors.why: Response command valid writing the response routing FIFO.

blocks.name: slave_response_fifo
blocks.description: Per-slave FIFO of master selects and decode errors steering B response mux.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].fifo_select
anchors.why: Per-slave FIFO of outstanding write master selects used to route B responses.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].b_select
anchors.why: FIFO-head master index selecting which master's B response returns to slave.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].fifo_wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Slave response FIFO write pointer, advanced on response command.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].fifo_rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Slave response FIFO read pointer, advanced when head entry is prefetched.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].fifo_decerr
anchors.why: Per-entry decode-error flags producing DECERR B responses.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].fifo_half_full_reg
anchors.why: Admission control: blocks new response commands when FIFO half full.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].fifo_rd_valid_reg
anchors.why: Valid flag of prefetched FIFO head driving b_valid.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].b_decerr
anchors.why: Forces DECERR bresp and local bvalid for unmapped writes.

blocks.name: slave_write_routing
blocks.description: Holds destination master or drop for the current slave write data beat.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].w_select_reg
anchors.why: Slave-side destination master for write data, from address decoder write command.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].w_drop_reg
anchors.why: Decode-error drop flag: accepts and discards slave write data instead of forwarding.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].w_select_valid_reg
anchors.why: Write data route valid; gates wvalid forwarding and m_wc_ready.

blocks.name: master_aw_arbiter
blocks.description: Per-master round-robin arbiter and address mux among slaves.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].a_grant
anchors.why: Per-master one-hot round-robin grant among requesting slaves; gates request and acknowledge.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].a_grant_encoded
anchors.why: Encoded grant selects winning slave's awaddr/awprot/awvalid into the master register slice.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].a_grant_valid
anchors.why: Arbiter grant valid; qualifies muxed awvalid and write route loading.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].a_request
anchors.why: Arbiter requests gated by FIFO half-full and pending write route.

blocks.name: master_write_routing
blocks.description: Latches granted slave to mux its write data into the master.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].w_select_reg
anchors.why: Master-side write data mux select, latched from arbitration grant per transaction.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].w_select_valid_reg
anchors.why: Master write data route valid; gates wvalid mux and wready return.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].w_select_new_reg
anchors.why: Ensures write route loads once per new arbitration grant.

blocks.name: master_b_fifo
blocks.description: Per-master FIFO of slave indices routing B responses back.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].fifo_select
anchors.why: Per-master FIFO of granted slave indices routing B responses back.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].fifo_wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Master B-routing FIFO write pointer, advanced on AW accept.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].fifo_rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Master B-routing FIFO read pointer, advanced on B handshake.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].fifo_half_full_reg
anchors.why: Limits outstanding writes per master by blocking arbiter requests.

blocks.name: crossbar_matrix
blocks.description: Valid/ready interconnect matrices between slave and master sides.

anchors.name: int_axil_awvalid
anchors.why: Slave-by-master AW valid matrix feeding per-master arbiter requests.

anchors.name: int_axil_wvalid
anchors.why: Slave-by-master W valid matrix steered by slave write route.

anchors.name: int_axil_bvalid
anchors.why: Master-by-slave B valid matrix steered by master b_select.

blocks.name: register_slices
blocks.description: Slave- and master-side AXI-Lite write register slices.

anchors.name: s_axil_awvalid
anchors.why: Slave write-address valid into slave-side register slices.

anchors.name: m_axil_awvalid
anchors.why: Master write-address valid from master-side register slices.
